scope: Completion of Steffel 1791/1809 as a fully computational, AI-assisted historical-digital scholarly edition and reusable RHD reference implementation, with zero required human adjudication.
interpretation: Weighted completion of the machine-only scholarly edition. It is not a human-validation rate and does not imply a human-reviewed critical edition.

dimensions.label: Documentary coverage, segmentation and diplomatic transcription
dimensions.completion_gate: All candidate boundaries disposed and all active dictionary articles represented in the AI-assisted documentary layer.

dimensions.label: Machine recollation, uncertainty accounting and non-destructive critical status
dimensions.note: All 482 open cases have a machine epistemic disposition: 284 confirmed_ai_assisted, 152 corrected_ai_assisted and 46 unresolved_after_ai_recollation. Unresolved is an allowed terminal scholarly state in the machine-only edition.
dimensions.completion_gate: Every detected issue has a traceable machine disposition, including explicit unresolved status where evidence does not justify one reading.

dimensions.label: Reusable RHD 1.0 architecture and provenance
dimensions.completion_gate: Canonical model, source profiles, provenance and invariant tests are implemented without destructive migration.

dimensions.label: TEI/TEI Lex-0/IIIF interoperability
dimensions.note: The strict Lex-0 projection validates against the official TEI Lex-0 0.9.5 RNG. The rich RHD TEI and appendix supplement preserve non-Lex-0 layers. The 84-page canonical working facsimile remains fixed internally by SHA-256 4ccc94aaff1fcc948341a103255f2c3f52dd7b8ca488b6dc79a921b3c9d6244f. The Repositorio de Lenguas/Dropbox URL is explicitly treated as mutable: a later 2026-08-15 probe returned a different 438-page, 26,702,093-byte PDF (SHA-256 3c2169d818770fecff7eca822c7dcc52f35d66356c5279913d85fb5364c652ce), so it is diagnostic only and cannot close the IIIF gate. External Internet Archive items remain noncanonical unless independently proven identical. Remaining work is publication of stable IIIF-compatible page resources derived from the exact canonical witness and entry-region linking.
dimensions.completion_gate: Lex-0 validation remains green and the checksum-fixed canonical facsimile is linked through stable IIIF-compatible identifiers/images.

dimensions.label: Computational diachronic and comparative research
dimensions.note: All 298 candidate relations receive reproducible documentary-retrieval support scores from conservative graphemic similarity, internal attestations and reciprocal documentary support. Every relation remains candidate; no semantic, cognacy, etymological or continuity probability is fabricated.
dimensions.completion_gate: Computational candidate evidence is reproducible, calibrated through appropriate controls and published with explicit non-claims; no human adjudication is required by this scope.

dimensions.label: Numeration appendix, trilingual language sample and Lord's Prayer
dimensions.note: AI visual collation fixes PDF 79–84 to printed pp. 369–374. The numeration section is machine-structured; all 22 formulas have Latin/German/Tarahumara machine alignment with field confidence and explicit uncertainty; the separate Lord's Prayer has an AI visual transcription; all 24 appendix objects are canonicalized and serialized in a dedicated TEI supplement. Residual work is refinement of low-confidence historical glyph readings, which may legitimately remain explicit uncertainty at final release.
dimensions.completion_gate: Appendices are machine-processed, structurally encoded, aligned where appropriate, serialized and retain explicit uncertainty for non-secure readings.

dimensions.label: Scientific release, archive and citability
dimensions.note: A deterministic release integrity manifest hashes and verifies lexical/canonical data, appendices, visual appendix layers, documentary diachronic scores, TEI/Lex-0 products, schema, source profiles, witness identity evidence and both minimal and complete second-source industrialization outputs. Persistent archive/identifier and final stable release remain pending.
dimensions.completion_gate: Stable RHD release, integrity manifest, persistent archive/identifier and explicit machine-only conformity statement are published.

dimensions.label: End-to-end replication on a second historical source
dimensions.note: Miguel Joaquín Tellechea's 1826 Compendio gramatical is the deliberately different second-source industrialization pilot. Its public DGB PDF is checksum-fixed as RHD-WIT-TELLECHEA-1826-DGB (205 pages; 95,088,307 bytes; SHA-256 c67b7942090613c494d8057be8aff59ea13a11519c29eae469afad8a85c30dfc). After the two-unit minimum proof, the complete 205-page witness now traverses the declared RHD documentary pipeline in GitHub Actions. All 205 pages receive deterministic canonical documentary units; the output validates against the same RHD JSON Schema; a complete documentary TEI is generated; sparse pages use separate visual OCR fallback; the full artifact is uploaded reproducibly; no Lex-0 entries are fabricated; no universal-core redesign is required; and no human validation is claimed. This closes the RHD second-source industrialization gate without claiming a human-adjudicated critical edition of Tellechea.
dimensions.completion_gate: Closed: the complete declared Tellechea pilot witness traverses the RHD documentary pipeline with zero fundamental redesign of the universal core.
